{{Quote|A TaggeCo Purchasing Agent in Oxon once bragged he could buy the whole Naboo system with his personal expense account.|Rhys Dallows during a briefing|<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|1|The Starfighter Trap}}</ref>}}
A '''Purchasing Agent''' was a position within [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo.]] These agents were paid well, as one claimed that their expense account would be enough to purchase the entire [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]]. The agent made the remarks to [[Rhys Dallows]] while in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Oxon City|Oxon]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Gamer" />
